supersedes: Only classifications expressly changed here; the D21 map remains immutable, including its literal text and acceptance statuses.
interpretation: Twenty-seven obligations include duplicate requirements for the same operation in a required-skill list and a named AM02 route. They are not twenty-seven distinct operations.
Driver code, real UI/domain preparation, Session.skill loading, native inference, output publication and consumer execution remain separate evidence levels.
No absence of provider is used to stop implementable UI/domain/source/consumer work. No synthetic model, receipt, contribution or permissive authority is substituted.
An owner prerequisite does not erase the subsequent WP12 witness and consumer obligation. Every row records that remaining own action.
Latest owner sources and a consumed product are distinct; compatible intake requires exact pins and owner publication before a new hosted result can alter acceptance.

routine.external_delta: Publish the actual native recipe/admission/run/status/result/watch port, mount its descriptors with current principal/case/occurrence/source authority, then publish the minimal compatible closure for integration.
routine.consumer_after_delta: C07 factual result/readers, ExecutiveReviewInput or commitment watch consumer with actual current admission; no approval or domain application attributed to WP12.

work.own_action_now: Retain the real selection/UI availability observation and exact negative; inspect published work closure before intake. Do not insert a UI-owned selection ID into the model objective or satisfy the executive AM02 route with the question skill.
work.external_delta: Mount the owner-produced work signals and publish the legitimate relation from the mission's typed input/current case to the authorized work selection. WP10 W20 work changes are being reviewed separately; they are not silently inherited.
work.consumer_after_delta: Current Meu Trabalho items for the same question/action, including one item after consume/retry and retained recipient/source access.

forecast-kpi.own_action_now: Keep Forecast and BI route claims separate. Inspect only a published same-case/period Dashboard metric relation or a real Planner KPI interpretation; no policy or engine changes.
forecast-kpi.external_delta: Publish the legitimate metric selection/binding in the owner input/domain contract, preserving source incarnation, fields, version, period and current authorization.
forecast-kpi.consumer_after_delta: Forecast explanation retains the actual comparison and the related KPI evidence under the required Finance skill.

bi-kpi.own_missing_code: The BI08 milestone driver cannot exercise a budget KPI. A separate BI01 mission with two real public selections is statically viable and root-authorized; its new driver is the next own increment.
bi-kpi.blocking_fact: BI01 requires budgetSeries while total-budget requires budgetMetrics, so one selector cannot be reused. Two real same-case/same-period selections can supply the chart and auxiliary annual-total check. The current closed verifier permits only the BI source in ContextualBIProposal; the additional KPI source must remain attached to its own actual tool output/receipt in Session.
bi-kpi.own_action_now: Implement native-execution-bi-kpi.test.ts separately, issuing both real sources and discovering the KPI source through actual sf_case_read. Require the four normative BI operations and audit the native KPI result/receipt and its equality to twelve monthly effective values. Preserve the existing BI08 files and all contracts.
bi-kpi.external_delta: No source-selection change is required for this auxiliary check. The separately published missing artifact-handle discovery finding still limits full native ContextualBIProposal production; no private artifact/table identifier is supplied to the model.
bi-kpi.consumer_after_delta: WP05 consumes the actual BI01 proposal/table using its own source only. The KPI is an auxiliary model check retained in Session, not a new WP05 KPI consumer or a new numerical field in the proposal. This does not satisfy the separate Forecast AM02 KPI route.
